jobs.title: Director AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Position Description

CGI is Canada's largest independent information technology services firm, and after 50 years, we continue to grow. We are building a new AI engineering capability within our Toronto Financial Services (TFS) business unit, serving clients across Banking, Insurance, and Wealth Management.

We are looking for a Director, Consulting Services to build and lead this new capability. This is a people leadership role with accountability for the team, delivery, and client relationships. The AI engineering team will report to this role, including Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Co-op, Agentic AI Engineers, Founding AI Engineers, and the Distinguished AI Engineer.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay close to the work by building demos, helping shape complex solutions, and setting technical direction alongside the team. As a player-coach, you will develop people, build trusted client relationships, grow the capability, and remain actively engaged in how solutions are designed and built.

This role is hybrid and requires you to work from our downtown Toronto office and/or client office a minimum of two days per week, subject to change at any time.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Build, grow, and lead the AI engineering team, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

Own delivery across client engagements, with accountability for timelines, quality, and business value.

Build and maintain senior client relationships, develop trusted partnerships, grow accounts, and identify new opportunities.

Remain hands-on by building demos and proofs of concept and contributing to complex solutions.

Set technical direction and engineering standards for AI solutions in collaboration with the Distinguished AI Engineer.

Shape AI roadmaps and business cases in collaboration with CGI and client leadership.

Own estimates, budgets, and delivery plans for the team's work.

Maintain high standards for quality, security, and reliability across delivered solutions.

Build an inclusive, collaborative team culture that supports continuous learning and professional growth.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

12+ years of experience in software delivery or consulting, including experience leading teams.

Demonstrated people leadership experience building and leading engineering or delivery teams, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

Strong, current hands-on technical skills, with the ability to build demos and complex full-stack solutions using Java and Node.js and AI coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, or Claude Code.

Strong knowledge of building AI and agent-based products, including prompt, context, harness, and loop engineering.

Demonstrated experience owning client delivery, including estimates, budgets, plans, timelines, and quality.

Experience developing trusted relationships with senior client leaders and identifying opportunities to grow accounts.

Strong technical understanding of APIs, databases including PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and cloud technologies to effectively guide engineering teams.

Ability to connect AI initiatives to defined business outcomes and value.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts clearly to executives, clients, and engineering teams.

Assets

Experience in Banking, Insurance, or Wealth Management.

Experience establishing and growing a new practice or capability.

Consulting or professional services experience.

Public contributions to the AI community through speaking engagements, published writing, or open-source work.

Relevant cloud or delivery certifications, including Azure, AWS, or GCP.

**CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $145,000–$195,000. This role is an existing vacancy.**

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

CGI is Canada's largest independent information technology services firm, and after 50 years, we're still growing. We are building a new AI engineering capability within our Toronto Financial Services (TFS) business unit, serving organizations across Banking, Insurance, and Wealth Management.

We are looking for a Distinguished AI Engineering Specialist, the most senior technical individual contributor on the team. This is a Director-level role focused on technical leadership rather than people management.

In this role, you will set the technical direction for AI engineering across TFS while remaining hands-on. You will tackle complex engineering challenges, validate new approaches, develop reference implementations, and establish patterns that other engineers and teams can adopt.

You will help design the systems and engineering practices that support the broader group, advise clients and executives, and provide technical guidance to principal and staff engineers. This opportunity is suited to an experienced AI engineering consultant who has delivered AI systems at scale and wants to continue working directly with technology while providing organization-wide technical leadership.

Set the technical vision and architecture for AI engineering across TFS.
Remain hands-on by building complex components, validating new approaches, and developing reference code.
Design reusable engineering patterns, harnesses, and standards for adoption across teams.
Address complex technical challenges across teams and client engagements.
Advise client leaders and CGI executives, connecting AI capabilities to business objectives and value.
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to principal and team members.
Evaluate emerging tools and techniques and lead proofs of concept where appropriate.
Establish and maintain standards for the quality, safety, reliability, and scalability of AI systems.
Represent CGI's AI engineering capabilities with clients and the broader professional community.

10 to 20 years of experience building and delivering software, including deep and recent hands-on AI engineering experience.
Strong, current hands-on full-stack development skills, including Java, Node.js, APIs, and data technologies.
Expert knowledge of PostgreSQL and MongoDB, including database design and performance at scale.

Experience designing large-scale, reliable, secure distributed systems.
Demonstrated experience establishing evaluation, safety, testing, and reliability practices for production AI systems.

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Architecture & Pre-Sales
jobs.description:
This is a permanent full-time remote opportunity for those based and authorised to work in Canada, focusing on candidates based in the Toronto area.
At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of engineers, designers, data experts and strategists who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create software solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems, with confidence.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

About The Director, Solutions Architecture & Pre-Sales

As a Director, Solutions Architecture & Pre-Sales at Nearform, you'll be responsible for crafting, positioning, and scoping custom software and AI solutions that help enterprise clients unlock value. We're looking for a strategic, technical, and entrepreneurial leader who thrives at the intersection of enterprise software architecture, client advisory, and commercial deal shaping.

In this high-impact pre-sales leadership role, you will lead discovery engagements, architect technical solution blueprints, and navigate the commercial elements of complex project deliveries alongside our Sales and Delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnering:
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams to expand client partnerships through technical vision, AI innovation, and modern software strategy.

Client Insight & Executive Advisory:
Act as a trusted technical advisor on software architecture, cloud, data, and AI ecosystems—identifying complex client challenges and defining tailored technical solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

Pre-Sales Leadership & Discovery:
Lead discovery and pre-sales engagements, crafting proposals, RFP responses, and pitches that clearly communicate our AI and technology capabilities.

Solution Design
: Translate client objectives into an actionable solution roadmap and proofs-of-concept (POCs), working closely with experts in Software, Data, AI, Design, and engineering.

Solution Architecture & Scoping:
Translate client business objectives into actionable technical solution roadmaps, system architectures, and realistic project delivery scopes in collaboration with experts across Software, Data, AI, Design, and Engineering.

Delivery Alignment:
Support early-stage project kickoff to ensure a seamless transition from pre-sales solution design to execution.

Storytelling & Advisory:
Help shape Nearform's technical advisory frameworks and AI practices while creating compelling case studies that showcase the transformative power of our custom solutions.

Qualifications & Experience

12+ years of technical leadership experience within software engineering, technical consulting, or pre-sales engineering in a digital agency or custom software consultancy environment.
Demonstrated success leading pre-sales technical discovery, shaping enterprise deals, and writing technical proposals/RFPs.
Strong hands-on background in modern custom software design, web architectures, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), data pipelines, and AI
Working proficiency in at least one core programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) and familiar with AI-native software engineering practices and LLM integrations.
Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to lead interactive workshops, navigate complex client dynamics, and articulate outcome-based business value to technical and non-technical executives
Demonstrated success in engaging at executive VP/C-level within enterprise clients.
Comfort operating with ambiguity in early-stage scoping, balancing technical perfection with commercial reality.
Ability to collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Finance to craft tailored proposals and solutions.

Benefits & Perks

Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
Flexible Time Off Package - We offer a flexible annual leave policy plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in USD) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
401k - We offer a 401k plan and match up to 4%, with no minimum entry requirements and immediate vesting of employers’ contributions.

Inclusion

Inclusion is one of our core values. We don’t discriminate by race, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the country where employed. We are not offering working visa sponsorship at this time.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.

À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.

Indicateurs de performance

Assurer la production mensuelle des indicateurs de performance du département
Faire évoluer les processus de données sur la qualité client selon les normes les plus récentes et les positionner pour l'avenir.
Diriger une petite équipe de développeurs Power BI responsables des rapports départementaux.

Automatisation des processus

Agir en tant qu’analyste d’affaire et responsable de produit
Assurer la gestion d’un fournisseur externe de services de gestion de données pour soutenir l'amélioration des processus
Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes de solutions technologiques (DT) ainsi que les développeurs afin de tester et implanter les solutions en production.
Prioriser les éléments du back log en fonction de la valeur d'affaires, des risques, du ROI et des dépendances techniques.
Soutenir les forums d'utilisateurs et responsables d'unité d'affaires des processus afin de collecter leur requis de nouvelle solution ou améliorations;
Être un agent de transformation pour influencer sur l’amélioration des processus d’affaires
Communiquer l'avancement des projets et justifier les choix de priorisation.
Coordonner et exécuter le plan de test / Identifier les problèmes de test et participer à l’investigation;
Offrir du support aux utilisateurs lors de l’exécution des tests ‘’User Acceptance Testing’’ (UAT);
Faire appel à des compétences de gestion de projets, de prise de décisions en connaissant les risques encourus ainsi que de communiquer à différents niveaux;
Être un agent de changement en préparation au déploiement des nouvelles solutions
Préparer et présenter du matériel de formation à la suite du déploiement des nouvelles solutions

Formation gestionnaire d’échappé

Préparer et présenter le contenu pour la communauté de Pratique pour les gestionnaires d’échappé
Assurer la gouvernance du profil de formation des gestionnaires d’échappé.

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?

Doit être ingénieux, prendre de l’initiative et être un joueur d’équipe;
Bonne connaissance des processus d’affaires en lien avec le produit ;
Fortes habiletés interpersonnelles et de communication;
Esprit orienté vers la résolution de problèmes;
Expérience avec le service à la clientèle, investigation et retour de communication avec le client;
Un atout si vous connaissez déjà Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365;

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre des instructions spécialisées, des plans, des dessins et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et parfois communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours ; il suffit de lever les yeux. Êtes-vous prêt à vous dépasser ?

Le candidat retenu devra se soumettre à une vérification de ses antécédents judiciaires et obtenir toutes les autorisations nécessaires en lien avec la manipulation et le transfert de marchandises contrôlées. L’offre d’emploi est conditionnelle à la réussite de ces vérifications et à l’obtention des autorisations requises. Si ces conditions ne sont pas respectées, l’offre d’emploi sera retirée.

About Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters.

For nearly 100 years, our teams have been at the forefront of propulsion technology, pushing boundaries to make flight more efficient and reliable. Our engines support missions that truly matter, from transporting people and essential goods, to enabling emergency medical services, humanitarian operations, and wildfire suppression around the world.

An Employer of Choice

Pratt & Whitney Canada was named one of Canada’s Best Employers for 2026 by Forbes, marking the 11th consecutive year the company has earned this recognition. Pratt & Whitney Canada also ranked #1 employer in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. In addition, our headquarters continue to be recognized among the top employers in the Montreal region. Together, these distinctions reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, across Canada, and around the world.

The position is based at our Longueuil location from Monday to Friday, with flexible hours and exclusively on-site.

Performance Indicators

Ensure the monthly production of departmental performance indicators.
Develop data processes related to customer quality in line with the latest standards and position them for the future.
Lead a small team of Power BI developers responsible for departmental reports.

Process Automation

Act as a business analyst and product owner.
Manage an external data management service provider to support process improvement.
Collaborate with technology solutions teams (DT) and developers to test and implement solutions in production.
Prioritize backlog items based on business value, risks, ROI, and technical dependencies.
Support user forums and business unit process leaders to gather their requirements for new solutions or improvements.
Act as a transformation agent to drive business process improvements.
Communicate project progress and justify prioritization decisions.
Coordinate and execute the test plan/identify testing issues and participate in investigations.
Provide support to users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Utilize project management skills, make informed decisions understanding the associated risks, and communicate effectively across different levels.
Act as a change agent in preparation for the deployment of new solutions.
Prepare and deliver training materials following the deployment of new solutions.

Escape Management Training

Prepare and deliver content for the Community of Practice for Escape Leaders.
Ensure the governance of the training profile for Escape Leaders.

What do you need to succeed?

Must be resourceful, take initiative, and be a team player.
Strong knowledge of business processes related to the product.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Problem-solving-oriented mindset.
Experience in customer service, investigation, and providing customer feedback.
Experience with tools such as Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365 is an asset.

This position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a very good knowledge of English to read and understand, on a daily basis, documentation and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.

What do we offer?

Pension and savings plan with employer contributions
Group insurance program
Opportunities for advancement (career progression)
Merit or recognition program
Health and wellness program, including virtual health care
Recreational and sports club
Nearby daycares
Transportation accessibility or public transit program and free parking

Working at Pratt & Whitney Canada

The masculine pronoun is used without discrimination and solely for the purpose of making the text easier to read. We will consider applications from all qualified candidates.

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, we combine passion, boldness, and precision to design, manufacture, and maintain the most advanced and reliable aircraft engines in the world. Our work and the quality of our products contribute to the success of our customers, who in turn save lives, support commerce, connect communities, and protect freedoms.

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, you have the opportunity to make a difference every day—just look up. Are you ready to go beyond?

new_jobs.description:
This is a permanent full-time remote opportunity for those based and authorised to work in Canada, focusing on candidates based in the Toronto area.
At this time, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship.

About Nearform

Nearform is an independent team of engineers, designers, data experts and strategists who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create software solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.

Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems, with confidence.

Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.

About The Director, Solutions Architecture & Pre-Sales

As a Director, Solutions Architecture & Pre-Sales at Nearform, you'll be responsible for crafting, positioning, and scoping custom software and AI solutions that help enterprise clients unlock value. We're looking for a strategic, technical, and entrepreneurial leader who thrives at the intersection of enterprise software architecture, client advisory, and commercial deal shaping.

In this high-impact pre-sales leadership role, you will lead discovery engagements, architect technical solution blueprints, and navigate the commercial elements of complex project deliveries alongside our Sales and Delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partnering:
Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams to expand client partnerships through technical vision, AI innovation, and modern software strategy.

Client Insight & Executive Advisory:
Act as a trusted technical advisor on software architecture, cloud, data, and AI ecosystems—identifying complex client challenges and defining tailored technical solutions that deliver measurable business impact.

Pre-Sales Leadership & Discovery:
Lead discovery and pre-sales engagements, crafting proposals, RFP responses, and pitches that clearly communicate our AI and technology capabilities.

Solution Design
: Translate client objectives into an actionable solution roadmap and proofs-of-concept (POCs), working closely with experts in Software, Data, AI, Design, and engineering.

Solution Architecture & Scoping:
Translate client business objectives into actionable technical solution roadmaps, system architectures, and realistic project delivery scopes in collaboration with experts across Software, Data, AI, Design, and Engineering.

Delivery Alignment:
Support early-stage project kickoff to ensure a seamless transition from pre-sales solution design to execution.

Storytelling & Advisory:
Help shape Nearform's technical advisory frameworks and AI practices while creating compelling case studies that showcase the transformative power of our custom solutions.

Qualifications & Experience

12+ years of technical leadership experience within software engineering, technical consulting, or pre-sales engineering in a digital agency or custom software consultancy environment.
Demonstrated success leading pre-sales technical discovery, shaping enterprise deals, and writing technical proposals/RFPs.
Strong hands-on background in modern custom software design, web architectures, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), data pipelines, and AI
Working proficiency in at least one core programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) and familiar with AI-native software engineering practices and LLM integrations.
Exceptional communication skills with a proven ability to lead interactive workshops, navigate complex client dynamics, and articulate outcome-based business value to technical and non-technical executives
Demonstrated success in engaging at executive VP/C-level within enterprise clients.
Comfort operating with ambiguity in early-stage scoping, balancing technical perfection with commercial reality.
Ability to collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, and Finance to craft tailored proposals and solutions.

Benefits & Perks

Annual Company Bonus - We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.
Work Remotely and Flexibly - We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!
Flexible Time Off Package - We offer a flexible annual leave policy plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.
Remote Working Allowance - Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in USD) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.
Training and Development Allowance - Nearform is committed to supporting and investing in employees’ ongoing learning and professional development. You will be encouraged to pursue relevant learning opportunities that support your growth and the growth of others, subject to manager approval.
Healthcare - It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.
401k - We offer a 401k plan and match up to 4%, with no minimum entry requirements and immediate vesting of employers’ contributions.

Inclusion

Inclusion is one of our core values. We don’t discriminate by race, religion, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

All persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the country where employed. We are not offering working visa sponsorship at this time.

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct manual and electronic identity verification checks to confirm the identity of prospective employees.

À propos de Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) est un leader mondial de l’innovation aérospatiale, dont le siège social est situé à Longueuil, au Québec, depuis 1928. Nous concevons et fabriquons des moteurs d’aéronefs de nouvelle génération qui propulsent la plus grande flotte mondiale d’avions et d’hélicoptères dans les segments de l’aviation d’affaires, de l’aviation générale et de l’aviation régionale.

Depuis près de 100 ans, nos équipes sont à l’avant-garde des technologies de propulsion, repoussant les limites afin de rendre nos moteurs plus performants et fiables. Nos moteurs soutiennent des missions essentielles, du transport de passagers et de marchandises aux services médicaux d’urgence, aux opérations humanitaires et à la lutte contre les feux de forêt, partout dans le monde.

Un employeur de choix

Pratt & Whitney Canada a été reconnue comme l’un des meilleurs employeurs au Canada en 2026 selon Forbes, et ce, pour une 11e année consécutive. L’entreprise s’est également classée au premier rang des employeurs de l’industrie de l’aérospatiale et de la défense au pays. De plus, notre siège social figure toujours parmi les meilleurs employeurs de la région de Montréal. Ensemble, ces distinctions confirment notre réputation d’employeur de choix à Montréal, au Canada et à l’échelle mondiale.

Le poste s’effectue à notre établissement de Longueuil du lundi au vendredi, selon des horaires flexibles et exclusivement en présentiel.

Indicateurs de performance

Assurer la production mensuelle des indicateurs de performance du département
Faire évoluer les processus de données sur la qualité client selon les normes les plus récentes et les positionner pour l'avenir.
Diriger une petite équipe de développeurs Power BI responsables des rapports départementaux.

Automatisation des processus

Agir en tant qu’analyste d’affaire et responsable de produit
Assurer la gestion d’un fournisseur externe de services de gestion de données pour soutenir l'amélioration des processus
Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes de solutions technologiques (DT) ainsi que les développeurs afin de tester et implanter les solutions en production.
Prioriser les éléments du back log en fonction de la valeur d'affaires, des risques, du ROI et des dépendances techniques.
Soutenir les forums d'utilisateurs et responsables d'unité d'affaires des processus afin de collecter leur requis de nouvelle solution ou améliorations;
Être un agent de transformation pour influencer sur l’amélioration des processus d’affaires
Communiquer l'avancement des projets et justifier les choix de priorisation.
Coordonner et exécuter le plan de test / Identifier les problèmes de test et participer à l’investigation;
Offrir du support aux utilisateurs lors de l’exécution des tests ‘’User Acceptance Testing’’ (UAT);
Faire appel à des compétences de gestion de projets, de prise de décisions en connaissant les risques encourus ainsi que de communiquer à différents niveaux;
Être un agent de changement en préparation au déploiement des nouvelles solutions
Préparer et présenter du matériel de formation à la suite du déploiement des nouvelles solutions

Formation gestionnaire d’échappé

Préparer et présenter le contenu pour la communauté de Pratique pour les gestionnaires d’échappé
Assurer la gouvernance du profil de formation des gestionnaires d’échappé.

Qu’est-ce qu’il vous faut pour réussir ?

Doit être ingénieux, prendre de l’initiative et être un joueur d’équipe;
Bonne connaissance des processus d’affaires en lien avec le produit ;
Fortes habiletés interpersonnelles et de communication;
Esprit orienté vers la résolution de problèmes;
Expérience avec le service à la clientèle, investigation et retour de communication avec le client;
Un atout si vous connaissez déjà Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365;

Ce poste s’inscrit dans un milieu de travail francophone, néanmoins il nécessite une connaissance fonctionnelle de l’anglais pour lire et comprendre des instructions spécialisées, des plans, des dessins et des termes techniques qui peuvent émaner d’organisations internationales, ainsi que pour écrire et parfois communiquer en anglais avec des clients, des fournisseurs ou des collègues internationaux.

Travailler chez Pratt & Whitney Canada

Le masculin est utilisé sans discrimination et uniquement dans le but d’alléger le texte. Nous étudierons la demande d’emploi de tous les candidats qualifiés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, nous allions avec passion, audace et rigueur pour concevoir, fabriquer et entretenir les moteurs d’aéronefs les plus avancés et les plus fiables au monde. Notre travail et la qualité de nos produits contribuent au succès de nos clients, qui à leur tour sauvent des vies, soutiennent le commerce, connectent les communautés et protègent les libertés.

Chez Pratt & Whitney Canada, vous avez l’occasion de faire une différence tous les jours ; il suffit de lever les yeux. Êtes-vous prêt à vous dépasser ?

Le candidat retenu devra se soumettre à une vérification de ses antécédents judiciaires et obtenir toutes les autorisations nécessaires en lien avec la manipulation et le transfert de marchandises contrôlées. L’offre d’emploi est conditionnelle à la réussite de ces vérifications et à l’obtention des autorisations requises. Si ces conditions ne sont pas respectées, l’offre d’emploi sera retirée.

===============================================

About Pratt & Whitney Canada

Pratt & Whitney Canada (P&WC) is a global leader in aerospace innovation, proudly headquartered in Longueuil, Quebec, since 1928. We design and manufacture next-generation aircraft engines that power the world’s largest fleet of business, general aviation, and regional aircraft and helicopters.

For nearly 100 years, our teams have been at the forefront of propulsion technology, pushing boundaries to make flight more efficient and reliable. Our engines support missions that truly matter, from transporting people and essential goods, to enabling emergency medical services, humanitarian operations, and wildfire suppression around the world.

An Employer of Choice

Pratt & Whitney Canada was named one of Canada’s Best Employers for 2026 by Forbes, marking the 11th consecutive year the company has earned this recognition. Pratt & Whitney Canada also ranked #1 employer in the aerospace and defense industry in the country. In addition, our headquarters continue to be recognized among the top employers in the Montreal region. Together, these distinctions reinforce our reputation as an employer of choice in Montreal, across Canada, and around the world.

The position is based at our Longueuil location from Monday to Friday, with flexible hours and exclusively on-site.

Performance Indicators

Ensure the monthly production of departmental performance indicators.
Develop data processes related to customer quality in line with the latest standards and position them for the future.
Lead a small team of Power BI developers responsible for departmental reports.

Process Automation

Act as a business analyst and product owner.
Manage an external data management service provider to support process improvement.
Collaborate with technology solutions teams (DT) and developers to test and implement solutions in production.
Prioritize backlog items based on business value, risks, ROI, and technical dependencies.
Support user forums and business unit process leaders to gather their requirements for new solutions or improvements.
Act as a transformation agent to drive business process improvements.
Communicate project progress and justify prioritization decisions.
Coordinate and execute the test plan/identify testing issues and participate in investigations.
Provide support to users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Utilize project management skills, make informed decisions understanding the associated risks, and communicate effectively across different levels.
Act as a change agent in preparation for the deployment of new solutions.
Prepare and deliver training materials following the deployment of new solutions.

Escape Management Training

Prepare and deliver content for the Community of Practice for Escape Leaders.
Ensure the governance of the training profile for Escape Leaders.

What do you need to succeed?

Must be resourceful, take initiative, and be a team player.
Strong knowledge of business processes related to the product.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Problem-solving-oriented mindset.
Experience in customer service, investigation, and providing customer feedback.
Experience with tools such as Databricks, Power BI, SAP, ENOVIA, Confluence, JIRA, SharePoint, MS Office 365 is an asset.

This position is part of a French-speaking work environment, it requires a very good knowledge of English to read and understand, on a daily basis, documentation and technical terms that may emanate from international organizations, as well as to write and communicate in English with customers, suppliers or international colleagues.

What do we offer?

Pension and savings plan with employer contributions
Group insurance program
Opportunities for advancement (career progression)
Merit or recognition program
Health and wellness program, including virtual health care
Recreational and sports club
Nearby daycares
Transportation accessibility or public transit program and free parking

Working at Pratt & Whitney Canada

The masculine pronoun is used without discrimination and solely for the purpose of making the text easier to read. We will consider applications from all qualified candidates.

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, we combine passion, boldness, and precision to design, manufacture, and maintain the most advanced and reliable aircraft engines in the world. Our work and the quality of our products contribute to the success of our customers, who in turn save lives, support commerce, connect communities, and protect freedoms.

At Pratt & Whitney Canada, you have the opportunity to make a difference every day—just look up. Are you ready to go beyond?
